description: MiniMax Code desktop client: MiniMax's AI agent app for coding and office work, bundling a local runtime (mcode) with computer use and browser tools
notes: MiniMax Code 桌面端是 MiniMax 的 AI Agent 桌面客户端（编程与办公），内置本地运行时（含 mcode CLI）与电脑操控能力（系统要求：Windows 10 及以上，64 位）
- %APPDATA%\MiniMax：Electron 壳的 userData（窗口/界面状态、桌面端配置 minimax-agent-cn-config.json 等）
已 Junction 到 persist\AppData；若该目录已存在，会先整体搬到 persist 并在原位置留下 .backup-<时间戳> 备份
- %USERPROFILE%\.minimax：本地运行时与内置 mcode CLI 的数据根目录（登录凭据、会话、日志、Plugin、Skill），和独立安装的 MiniMax Code CLI 共用
按「共用目录不接管」的原则：本包不为它建 Junction、也不设置 MINIMAX_DATA_DIR，桌面端与 CLI 都使用默认位置；卸载本包不影响 CLI（反之亦然）
应用首次启动会注册 minimax-cn:// 深链（HKCU\Software\Classes\minimax-cn），并默认写入开机自启（设置里可关闭）；卸载本包时会清理指向本包的深链与自启项
应用自带自动更新（electron-updater，更新源为 filecdn.minimax.chat 的 minimax-agent-prod\release）；由 Scoop 管理时建议在设置里关闭自动更新，改用 scoop update minimax-code-desktop 升级
安装包是 x64/arm64 双架构安装器，Scoop 会按当前架构解出 app-64.7z 或 app-arm64.7z；Scoop 不运行官方安装器，因此不会写注册表卸载项，也不会添加防火墙规则
卸载只删除 Junction 链接、深链与自启项，persist 数据保留（scoop uninstall -p 才会连数据一起删除）
pre_install: # Drop the NSIS leftovers ($PLUGINSDIR, $R0 and the uninstaller stub). Retry, because a virus
# scanner can hold the freshly extracted files for a moment.
if ($stuck.Count -gt 0) { Write-Host ('Could not remove some NSIS leftovers (harmless): ' + ($stuck -join ', ')) }
post_install: Write-Host ('Already linked, leaving it as is: ' + $Source)
if (-not $item.PSIsContainer) { throw ('Path exists and is not a directory: ' + $Source) }
Write-Host ('Copy to persist failed, keeping the existing dir: ' + $Source)
Write-Host ('Moved the previous data dir to: ' + $backup)
Write-Host ('Cannot rename the existing dir, skipped linking: ' + $Source)
Write-Host ('Linked app data dir to persist: ' + $Source)
# The local runtime data root (~/.minimax) is shared with the standalone MiniMax Code CLI,
# so it is deliberately left where it is: no junction, no MINIMAX_DATA_DIR.
post_uninstall: Write-Host ('Link points elsewhere, leaving it alone: ' + $Path + ' -> ' + $target)
# Remove-Item -Force can throw a NullReferenceException on junctions in PS 5.1
Write-Host ('Removed link, data is kept in persist: ' + $Path)
# the app registers the minimax-cn:// deep link on first launch:
# drop the registration only when it points at this package's install dir
Write-Host ('minimax-cn:// is registered by another copy, leaving it alone: ' + $cmd)
# the app (runOnStartup defaults to on) keeps a Run entry pointing at its exe:
# drop it only when it points at this package
Write-Host ('Removed the auto-start entry left by the app: ' + $_.Name)
